verdict.rationale: The only OpenAPI spec found (docs.x.ai/openapi.json) documents xAI's model REST API, a different product, and has zero Grok Bot paths. A runtime probe found no public Grok Bot API in the grok-bot docs, and the product is driven only through its own apps. A downloadable spec is a fair question for a SaaS agent product, so the axis applies, but there is no evidence the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
